development: CityFlowV2 official train S01, five complete cameras; new development scene, not a holdout
holdout: CityFlowV2 official train S03, six complete cameras; held out locally from all candidate/padding selection
scope: Two separate Dubuque intersections/camera groups, not cross-city validation or an official challenge submission
inference: Frozen pretrained YOLO11n COCO, 640 px, confidence 0.25, ByteTrack, every consecutive frame; no CityFlow detector training
cadence: Use actual per-camera source FPS for frame matching, including S03 c015 at 8 FPS
candidate_track_filter: Same as v6: vehicle class, at least 3 points, median raw box area >=1000 px, at least half raw box centres in official ROI
geometric_projection: Raw box bottom centre; standard OpenCV radial undistortion where supplied, then inverse source homography and local angular-to-metre approximation
appearance: Four actual crops per track, normalized HSV/Lab histograms; weak color evidence, not a trained vehicle-ReID network. All descriptors/crops/trajectories remain local.

development_grid.selection: Highest S01 global same-observation-cohort IDF1, tie favors fewer accepted associations then smaller padding. Freeze exact settings and sources before S03 ground truth is loaded.

annotation_convention: The official FAQ documents enlarged reference boxes. Padding is a separately labelled annotation alignment ablation; it is not improved physical localization. Hold raw-box ROI eligibility fixed so padding does not alter observation counts.
metrics: TrackEval Identity, 0.5 box IoU; all independently annotated multi-camera vehicles remain in the denominator. Report raw boxes before/after association and chosen annotation-aligned boxes before/after association on identical observations.
secondary_multicamera_filter: Report separately: retain only identities associated across at least two cameras, keeping all reference labels. Changed prediction cohort must never be called a same-detection improvement.
freeze_order: Write each label-blind association map locally before any corresponding reference evaluation. Complete inference may precede association freeze but no S03 GT scores or identity tuning may.
publication: Aggregate results and generic code only; no raw CityFlow media, crops, descriptors, GPS trajectories, source GT or dataset-trained model deployment. Preserve v6 S02 regression and the initial v7 geometric S02 ablation.

additional_development_candidate.model: Open Model Zoo vehicle-reid-0001 / OSNet-AIN, pretrained vehicle-specific 512-D descriptors, MIT license
additional_development_candidate.input: Four actual raw RGB vehicle crops per track, Pillow bilinear 208x208; original ONNX contains learned instance normalization
additional_development_candidate.padding: Keep 10 px per edge from S01 annotation-convention development; raw-box 0 px remains a separate ablation
additional_development_candidate.selection: Compare S01 same-cohort IDF1 against the preserved color-descriptor candidate; freeze the selected feature method, thresholds and source hashes before S03 scores
additional_development_candidate.publication: No CityFlow crops or descriptors redistributed; no vendor benchmark accuracy presented as ATLAS results
